title: Wireframes That Show Learning Logic
description: AIL 606 textbook section connecting wireframes that show learning logic to the annotated wireframe with per-region learner-action and sequence-phase labels, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Annotate each wireframe region with the learner action it supports and its sequence position.
Detect contradictions between a screen's purpose and its interaction affordances.
Encode instructional intent through layout choices (button placement, feedback timing).
Critique a wireframe as a teaching decision, not as a visual arrangement.
